snippet.title: HIRU Teaser Trailer - August 2025
snippet.description:
HIRU : Mansa Assegai

HIRU is a 3D African action-adventure where you avenge your clan and rescue your kidnapped sister from poachers across savannas, forests, and deserts.

Join and wishlist the game: https://www.kuntacontent.com/waitlist
